sol_usd_reference_source: CoinGecko connected market data at 2026-10-20 ~17:17 UTC
method: Mint transfer from pool=buy, to pool=sell. Fee payers are not verified unique humans. Quote amount from matching wrapped SOL transfers to pool or from pool to fee payer; missing quotes excluded from notional and OHLC. USD = SOL * one contemporary CoinGecko spot price, so historical USD candles are estimated. Raw and >=$5 OHLC both retained. Only observed parsed transactions, no invented fills.
